programs.title: The Woohoos!
programs.desc: The Woohoos wake up on a foggy morning and think Wise Island has floated up into the clouds. They discover that sometimes it gets cloudy on the ground, then it clears when the sun shines.

programs.title: Nikhil & Jay
programs.sub_title: Nikhil and Jay and the Supermoon
programs.desc: Nikhil and Jay want to stay awake to see the supermoon and eat a moonlit picnic! Amma and Appa think they should have a nap first but the boys have a different idea.

programs.title: Daniel Tiger's Neighbourhood
programs.sub_title: Prince Wednesday Gives Away His Book
programs.desc: The Royal Family donates used books to the Neighbourhood library so that Daniel and the other neighbours can enjoy them as well. Later, Daniel chooses to give away his special binoculars to Prince Wednesday.

programs.title: Mittens & Pants
programs.desc: Pants' dad baked too many puppy treats. So Pants decides to invite all his friends to a puppy treat picnic,  only to learn that not every animal eats the same things.

programs.title: BeddyByes
programs.desc: MeMo's den is not big enough for two. BaBa wants to build a den that they can both enjoy so MeMo shows BaBa how. They build a den for the Yummies that's just right.

programs.title: Mixmups
programs.desc: The Mixmups find party items and wish they had something to celebrate. The friends decide to mix up an adventure and have a Happy Friends Day Party.

programs.title: Ready Eddie Go!
programs.desc: Eddie discovers he has itchy headlice and learns what they are from Nina and Akil. With patient combing, he finds that dealing with them isn't scary after all.

programs.title: Bluey
programs.desc: Bluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. But armed with a magic featherwand that makes things incredibly heavy, Bingo can now stop them leaving the house.

programs.title: Fizzy And Suds
programs.desc: At the beach, it's so much fun making sandcastles and watching crabs. Come join our beachy bubbles and don't forget to slip, slop, slap to stay sun safe!
